note: Plan 6 — per-series liquidity probe. Verified findings driving it: (1) plan 5's 25-page cursor sweep (5000 unique markets) was 100% KXMVECROSSCATEGORY sports combos, every market vol 0 / liq 0 — the host's default /markets order leads with freshly created combo churn, so a blind sweep can never find liquid markets; (2) plan 3's per-series queries work and showed the only real flow sits on directional/above-below series (NASDAQ100U top strike vol24=4). So this plan probes 64 curated recurring (hourly/daily/weekly/monthly) non-sports series — all 10 plan-3 pilots, the index series, top crypto coins, major FX, commodities, top-8 US-city hourly temperature, and the CPI family — 20 markets each, ranked locally by volume_24h/liquidity to select universe.json (forward desk) and the backtest archive (long-dated, candles back to 2026-07-24). Plan 7 captures orderbooks + candles for the winners.
